narr: A boundary remain draped overhead while a deep southerly flow ushered in plenty of moisture. Showers and thunderstorms resulted in heavy rainfall that led to an instance of flash flooding.
ev: Broad Branch Road NW was closed both ways around Brandywine Street NW.
lsr: BROAD BRANCH ROAD NW CLOSED BOTH WAYS BETWEEN BRANDYWINE STREET NW & BEACH DRIVE NW DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
